ALL.rule: GET every reachable head, canonical order

BC-union.feedback: exactly the terminal rewards PPO's rollouts queried (same count)
BC-union.rule: Seq-BC on DP targets recomputed from PPO's queried feedback only

F-resident.rule: STOP at once under the F-resident renderer identity (resident method list on every request); its own terminal table; never called OFF

Fixed-best.rule: the single subset with the best mean train reward; unreachable heads dropped

OneShot.rule: choose a subset once before reading

PPO-NoText.rule: identical to PPO except the text features
PPO-NoText.sees: as PPO minus the delivered reading text

Random.rule: uniform over reachable subsets of size k; headline k = round(mean GETs of PPO on dev), all k reported

Rule.rule: pre-registered on B0 visible surface cues: RS if advice_request; ME+MS if back_reference or temporal_marker; MP if history exists and back_reference; else STOP

contrasts: does context-dependent choice beat not learning
does reading before deciding add value
RL update rule with the feedback count controlled
is the delivered text used for the next decision
does any fixed resource use help
resident skill text vs true OFF

diagnostic.Oracle: exact DP on the complete table of the evaluated prefix; privileged, never deployed

missing: prefixes with any pending terminal are excluded for every arm and reported
multiplicity: Holm over the 7 pre-registered contrasts; owner-cluster bootstrap CIs; S288/M482/L-realized748 are planned tiers only (L960 infeasible)
